milestones.outcome: The BPR publish-release workflow allocates one durable release candidate build number and binds it through all native identities, artifacts and public diagnostics while preserving installed updater compatibility.
exit_criteria: Durable allocation and unchanged retry preserve one number for one exact source/configuration cohort; changed inputs cannot reuse it and local builds allocate nothing.
About, copied version facts, diagnostics and native bundle/image/installer/package metadata expose the checked marketing version and common cohort number.
Source, SPDX, provenance, manifests and canonical asset names bind the cohort; the guarded publisher refuses mixed identities and validates the exact legacy ZIP alias.
Focused public-path, recovery and misuse proofs plus actual native identity observations pass; remaining release/version/security acceptance is explicitly preserved.
milestones.boundary: BPR only. Preserve published v0.4.0 tag/source/assets, original qualification reports, other owner work and the separate pending AgentSkills publication decision. No next semantic version or publication is selected by this milestone.
